name: Vichy Mineral 89

lead: Vichy Mineral 89 is a daily facial serum-gel made from Vichy's mineralizing thermal water and hyaluronic acid. It is aimed at hydration and strengthening the skin barrier, giving skin a fuller, more even look.
A 2019 expert-panel review of seven dermatologists discussed how environmental exposures affect skin and the role of M89 in barrier support.

paras: It is applied as a serum on cleansed skin in a daily routine, usually under moisturiser and sunscreen.
Generally a gentle cosmetic; as with any topical, people with sensitivities may react.

angle.text: People use it as a hydrating base step to improve how the skin looks and feels.

lead: Vichy Mineral 89, also called M89, is a hyaluronic acid and mineralized thermal water gel designed to restore and maintain skin barrier function.[1]
A 2019 review in the Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology reports an expert panel of seven dermatologists discussing the skin exposome and the role of M89 for facial skin quality.[1]

paras: The review describes M89 as a mineralized thermal water and hyaluronic-acid-based gel containing ingredients to support physical, hydric, antioxidant and antimicrobial skin functions.[1]

A 2019 expert-panel review discussed the product alongside literature on exposome factors such as ultraviolet radiation, pollution and smoking.[1] The review is a panel discussion rather than a controlled trial.
